senses.gloss: , read: דִּיפְּלִין m. pl. (pl. of διπλός) double (years), double age, i.e. 140 years (Ps. XC, 10).
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 59">Gen. R. s. 59</cite> (expl. <he>בא בימים</he>, <cite ref="Genesis 24:1">Gen. XXIV, 1</cite>) <he>בא בדי׳</he> (some ed. <he>בדיופ׳</he>, Yalk. ib. 103 <he>בדוּפְּלִין</he>) he was entering into his double age (approaching his one hundred and fortieth year; cmp.
Gen. XXI, 5; XXV, 20); comment.: double world (this life and the hereafter).
